key_innovations.title: Grafana Stack Evolution and Complexity Backlash
key_innovations.description: Developer critique of Grafana observability stack evolution from simple Docker setup to complex enterprise licensing
key_lessons: Label cardinality issues affect ALL logging systems, not just Grafana
Managed services reduce operational overhead vs self-hosted stacks
Licensing changes can erode developer trust and adoption
Simple Docker Compose setups don't always scale smoothly

Document observability best practices for contributors

key_innovations.title: docker-compose as Universal Container Definition Format
key_innovations.description: AWS Copilot community requesting docker-compose import feature, indicating compose as de facto standard for local development
key_lessons: docker-compose is the industry standard for local multi-container development
Developers want compose as source of truth, not separate cloud configs
Tooling gap: compose → cloud provider conversion is manual and error-prone
83% of Docker discussions mention compose (dominant presence)
chained_actions: Create script to validate docker-compose ↔ Cloud Run config consistency
Consider compose as source of truth for service definitions
Improve docker-compose documentation for contributor onboarding

key_innovations.title: Managed Services Preference Over Self-Hosted Infrastructure
key_innovations.description: Industry trend toward cloud-native managed services to reduce operational overhead
key_lessons: Self-hosted observability stacks have high operational overhead
Cloud-native services (Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring) reduce complexity
Managed services allow focus on product vs infrastructure maintenance
Cost predictability often better with managed services
chained_actions: Continue leveraging GCP Cloud Run (serverless containers)
Resist temptation to build custom infrastructure unnecessarily

key_innovations.title: Kubernetes Complexity Avoidance via Serverless Containers
key_innovations.description: Docker community showing preference for simpler orchestration (docker-compose, Cloud Run) over Kubernetes complexity
key_innovations.source: Inferred from compose dominance (83% vs 1% k8s)
key_lessons: Kubernetes mentions rare (1%) vs docker-compose dominant (83%)
Developers prefer serverless containers (Cloud Run, ECS) for simplicity
Orchestration complexity is avoided when not strictly necessary
Cloud Run provides sufficient orchestration for most workloads
chained_actions: Validate Cloud Run choice for agent deployments (correct decision)
Document simplicity advantage in architecture decisions
Resist Kubernetes migration unless clear scaling need emerges

key_innovations.title: Developer Experience as Competitive Differentiator
key_innovations.description: DX prioritization over raw features, with tools focusing on ease of use and integration
key_lessons: Grafana licensing deteriorated DX → user exodus
AWS Copilot compose integration addresses DX pain point
Simplicity and ease of use are increasingly valued
Good documentation and local dev setup matter for adoption
chained_actions: Ensure docker-compose local dev setup 'just works'
